about: A bundle with an asset in it and no binding anywhere. Its asset is referenced, so §8.6's orphan finding stays silent, and the cascade starts at a subject and never arrives — nothing resolves it at any position. Info: assembling a bundle before deciding what it is for is an ordinary state of an unfinished film.

findings.message: Bundle "Kitchen plates" is bound to no character, prop or location, so no query returns its assets.
findings.title: Bundle reaches no subject
